notes.title: Performance, UI and bugs
notes.content:
Performance, UI and bugs

I've been hard at work over the past month, focusing mainly on performance optimizations, UI, alongside bug fixing and some refactoring, sadly nothing too fancy to show this month but some core improvements to the games features.

Performance Boost
I've dedicated a significant amount of time to optimizing the game's performance, shifting to a more data orientated design. You should notice a smoother experience, especially when selecting objects and managing your town. I've also optimized the animation system and the logic for checking tasks, which should lead to better overall performance.


Production
I've also recently reimplemented and redesigned the production systems allowing for a more focused production per building and also integrating the building creator with these systems so that a player can place a stove and the building has the ability to produce cooked foods, etc. 

UI Enhancements
The user interface has received a lot of love this month. I've added new inspector panels for buildings and citizens, making it easier to see what's going on in your town at a glance. I've also done a lot of work under the hood to refactor the UI code, which will make it easier for me to add new UI features in the future.

New Job
I've added a "Gatherer" job for your citizens. This will allow you to assign citizens to only gather berries and other forgeable items. 

Bug Squashing
As with any development process, there have been a few bugs to squash. I've fixed a critical bug that was causing citizens to not die correctly, as well as a bug that was preventing farms from being auto-harvested. I've also fixed an issue where houses were not being assigned a spawn location and many more.

What's Next?
I'll be continuing to work on improving performance, adding new features, and fixing bugs.

Thank you for reading.

notes.title: Tech, Roads and Buildings
notes.content:
New Models 
I decided to buy some assets to bring the game visuals to where I wanted them, I believe in the short term this will save me a ton of time making assets in blender and allow me to spend more time on the systems at the core of the game rather than art, although maybe in the future I will have the time to create my own models and craft a visual look I am happy with.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45623940/97a724fd46ea2698f4059e85f57c97edcac8c676.png"]
Roads
I've implemented the first iteration of the road network, these roads are not only visual they boost movement speed and also offer the citizen a more performant path finding allowing the game to run faster and help citizens navigate the world with ease. Additionally there is only one road network system, meaning all roads will be connected and will function as the life line of the city.  


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45623940/a57f30f1832fe02e0db18789d9153f90f01ff566.png"]Technology Tree
I have spent a great amount of time hand crafting a tech tree that is in depth and balanced. The categories of tech are:


Agriculture
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45623940/5f9d10b107ad9cf4e893a2847748c910c2a5911b.png"]
Industry
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45623940/d33dcb300378618715ed97bcd52d7184f8d08457.png"]
Services
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45623940/191f6a398d76727f847c6e4efce914971d3015f4.png"]
Knowledge 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45623940/a8aa005ed962e042003c3af592cd4e657ab6c804.png"]

I believe these tech categories effectively cover all types of technologies in real life. Although this is the first iteration so  do expect it to change over time as the game evolves. 
Tech points will be produced by universities worked by your citizen and will acculturate over time to be spent on tech you want to unlock.

Thankyou for reading!

I'll get the colors right one day!

notes.title: Visual Rework
notes.content:
Orthographic Design  

I've been working on refining the visual style of my city-building game, and I’ve decided to transition to a cleaner, orthographic-ish look. This update brings a sharper and more structured visual idea to my game whilst maintaining some depth.

Instead of just making the camera a traditional ortho graphic camera, I turned down the FOV to 20 and zoomed the camera out to achieve a look that is similar to true orthographic mode.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45623940/dc550819c137f05678bbb52105f19a357639845a.png

Although I'm not happy with the overall color composition, I think it is a step in the right direction.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45623940/666537a18c2a534940d3ded5eafd4d27b4f76304.png

I am still working on polishing the building creator, adding images for the buttons will be the next step and I am can't wait to add more building parts so players can build their city in what ever style they would like.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45623940/c73ff22c5e7bfb7592d814044aa90c3f75ab712a.png

A real challenge for this game is keeping it looking good and consistent when zoomed all the way in and when zoomed all the way out. It needs more work and the moon/sun could also do with some love but I will get it looking better.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45623940/e0086e64999415d9b9350300f4ab636e8100b93a.png

Additionally I have reworked the UI visuals to be a simple box style with a border, I like the simplicity of this look and believe it fits well within the games styling and plan to add a setting to scale all the UI up or down how the player would like.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45623940/b96369e245d13f2ad174e64bdf291060c1dec79d.png 

If you have any art suggestions please feel free to reach out.

Cheers,
- Marcus
